e2e_path_override.note: configs/ablation/sample_image does not exist in the repo; overridden to configs/toy/sample_image

_lens_variables_trainable.note: the flat vector of trainable values; this is what LM updates

initial_variables_full.note: full variable vector including frozen entries

optimization_mask.note: True where a variable is trainable

variable_layout.note: packing order of the flat variable vector

ray_directions_only.note: unit direction per field, before pupil sampling

r_norm_check.note: direction cosines must be unit length

per_event_steps.note: one entry per yielded ray-tracing event, in sequence order

r_at_sensor.note: ray coordinates at the image plane

y_centroid.note: weighted mean ray height per field

transverse_ray_aberrations_x.note: per-ray x deviation from the centroid (epsilon_x in the paper)

transverse_ray_aberrations_y.note: per-ray y deviation from the centroid (epsilon_y in the paper)

data_collection_keys.note: intermediate ray-tracing quantities the residuals need

weights_by_name.note: weight and constraint flag per residual term

residual_vector_table.note: one row per residual term actually produced this call

residual_vector.note: stacked residuals from every term; this is l(x)

n_constraints.note: zero in every shipped config: no residual sets constraint=True

damping_terms.note: column norms of J, clamped; the diagonal of the damping matrix

gradient_JT_r.note: J^T l, the gradient of the scalar loss

step_dot_gradient.note: negative value confirms the step is a descent direction

iteration_history.note: one row per LM iteration from the perturbed start

L0_scalar_e2e_loss.note: L0: the scalar end-to-end (image) loss at the current spot diagram

grad0.note: dL/d(xy) evaluated at xy0, treated as a constant

xy_control.note: xy': the virtual target the least-squares problem drives rays toward

xy_control_shift.note: how far the lift displaces each ray's target

e2e_residual_vector.note: l(xy): the generalized transverse ray aberrations

reference_matches_manual.note: manual reproduction agrees with the shipped method

psf_abs_size_mm.note: physical extent of the PSF window on the sensor

rgb_psfs.note: per-field RGB PSFs from kernel density estimation of the spot diagram

psf_energy_per_field.note: each PSF integrates to ~1 unless rays were lost off the grid

psf_grid.note: PSFs interpolated onto the patch grid for spatially-varying convolution

blurred_image.note: output of the SVOLA patch convolution

mse_wiener_vs_sharp.note: lower than the blurred MSE means the Wiener stage helped

mse_chainer_vs_sharp.note: NAFNets are randomly initialized here, so this is not a trained result
